usage: PROG release-stats [-h] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
 [--dataset-version {v1,v2,both}]
 [--confirm-repo REPO_ID] [--apply]
 [--hf-token HF_TOKEN]
 [--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}] [--dry-run]
 [--source-revision SOURCE_REVISION]
 [--data-revision DATA_REVISION]
 [--generated-on GENERATED_ON]

options:
 -h, --help show this help message and exit
 --data-root DATA_ROOT Data root directory
 --dataset-version {v1,v2,both}
 Which published contract to release (default: both)
 --confirm-repo REPO_ID Exact target repo id; repeat once per released dataset
 --apply Publish and verify (default: dry run)
 --hf-token HF_TOKEN
 --log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}
 --dry-run Use a stub HF client (no network)
 --source-revision SOURCE_REVISION
 Pinned source/PBF revision to record in the release provenance
 --data-revision DATA_REVISION
 Pinned processed-data revision to record in the release provenance
 --generated-on GENERATED_ON
 Optional pinned YYYY-MM-DD card metadata; omitted by default
